venues.name: ACM IMWUT

venues.cycle: three new-submission cycles a year (1 Feb, 1 May, 1 Nov)
venues.venue_notes: IMWUT is the journal; UbiComp/ISWC is the conference where its papers are presented. Authors of accepted papers are invited to present at UbiComp/ISWC each year. Cycle deadlines are set by the journal, not the conference.
venues.submission_cycle: Fixed cycles. New submissions: 1 February, 1 May, 1 November. Major-revision resubmissions: 1 February, 1 May, 1 August, 1 November — 1 August is resubmission-only and closed to new submissions. A paper that receives major revisions may resubmit at either of the two deadlines following its original submission.

dates.label: New submissions: 1 November
